title: UTAS Motorsport — LiDAR Autonomy
description: End-to-end autonomous-vehicle software prototype for UTAS Motorsport's driverless program.
bullets: Built a full pipeline in CARLA, ROS 2 and RViz: virtual 40-channel LiDAR, DBSCAN cone detection, multi-frame tracking, KISS-ICP localisation, centre-path generation and path following.
Validated with multi-lap, multi-track, sensor-fault and dynamic-obstacle tests — 8/8 scenarios and 24/24 laps passed in the final software matrix.
Built the official Hesai ROS 2 driver for upcoming Pandar40P hardware testing.

title: AI-Native Payment & Agent Engineering Lab
description: A payment-processing prototype and a read-only operations copilot, built to find where agent workflows break rather than to demo where they work.
bullets: Designed a FastAPI/SQLite payment-processing prototype normalising synchronous, webhook and polling results from three simulated channels through adapters, event de-duplication, audit logging and a deterministic state machine.

Verified a read-only RAG operations copilot with three tools and a Planner–Developer–Tester–Reviewer process, using 77 automated tests, 11 documented failure cases, human approval and code-level safety gates.

title: Bili Cache Watch
description: Local full-stack web app for managing cached Bilibili videos across folders, emulators and mobile cache files.
bullets: Created a local full-stack application managing three cache sources - local folders, Android emulators, and mobile cache files - with SQLite-backed storage.
Implemented API-based availability checks, local playback, time-synchronised danmaku, MP4 export, scheduled background checks, multilingual UI, and Docker deployment.

title: Tasmania Tech / Research Intelligence Dashboard
description: Dashboard analysing GitHub repositories and research projects connected to Tasmania and UTAS.
bullets: Built a Tasmania-focused dashboard to analyse GitHub repositories and University of Tasmania research projects using API and CSV/JSON data.
Processed and classified repository data, visualised project activity and technology stacks in Power BI, and integrated a lightweight RAG assistant for repository-based Q&A.

title: Personal English Bank
description: A traceable personal English-learning workflow built with Next.js, NestJS, Prisma and SQL Server.

title: UE5 Financial Education Capstone
description: Modular UE5 financial-education system with AI-driven NPCs and a FastAPI + RAG backend.
bullets: Created a modular UE5 interactive experience with AI-driven NPCs, configurable questions, scoring workflows, PBR environments, and VR-ready interactions.
Connected the UE5 client to FastAPI, structured question data, RAG retrieval, and LLM services, then validated API, integration, and end-to-end interaction workflows.

title: AI Town Multi-Agent Simulation
description: Django-based virtual town simulation focused on multi-agent behaviour and memory-driven planning.
bullets: Architected a Django-based multi-agent virtual town implementing observation, memory, reflection, planning, event interactions, logging, replay, and web visualisation for AI education.

title: Little Red: Sequel
description: Independently developed story-driven 3D pixel-style Unreal Engine indie game demo.
bullets: Developed a story-driven 3D pixel-style Unreal Engine game demo featuring dark-fantasy worldbuilding, hub-based exploration, nonlinear quests, interactive dialogue, and multiple endings.
Designed Blueprint systems for quests, dialogue, levels, scenes, menus, and AIGC-assisted asset production, combining 2D pixel art with 3D environments.
